basic_details.job_title: NeGD Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Full Stack Developer, AI/ML Engineer & Other Posts
basic_details.short_information: NeGD Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by the National e-Governance Division (NeGD) under Digital India Corporation for 3 vacancies, including Full Stack Developer (AI/ML & Web Applications), AI/ML Engineer and Data Scientist (AI & ML) posts. Candidates with B.E./B.Tech., M.Tech., MCA, M.Sc. or other relevant qualifications and the required professional experience can apply online.

how_to_apply: Visit the official online registration portal at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/.
Complete the online application form with required personal, educational, and professional details.
Upload necessary documents and submit the application on or before 26.10.2026.

Candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central/State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel or attach a No Objection Certificate from their employer, or produce it at the time of interview.

rows.details: National e-Governance Division (NeGD) / Digital India Corporation
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Full Stack Developer (AI/ML & Web Applications), AI/ML Engineer, Data Scientist (AI & ML)
Maximum 55 years on the closing date of receipt of application
New Delhi (transferable to project locations of NeGD)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Experience Requirements: Full Stack Developer: 4+ years of professional full-stack development (5+ years preferred); minimum 2 years building and deploying AI- or ML-powered features in production applications. AI/ML Engineer: 4+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying AI/ML models (6+ years preferred); minimum 3 years training or fine-tuning deep learning models that were deployed in production. Data Scientist: 4+ years in data science, machine learning or applied AI (6+ years preferred); minimum 3 years developing models or AI systems deployed in production or used in operational decisions. rows.essential_qualification: B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech., MCA or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI/ML or a related discipline. Candidates with strong verifiable work (production applications or significant open-source contributions) will be considered in lieu of formal qualification.

B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech./M.S. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Electronics or a related discipline. Candidates from non-traditional backgrounds with strong verifiable work (published models, competition results or significant open-source contributions) will be considered in lieu of formal qualification.

B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech./M.S. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, AI/ML or a related quantitative discipline. Candidates with strong verifiable work (Kaggle Expert level or above, published research or significant open-source contributions) will be considered in lieu of formal qualification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NeGD Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official online registration portal at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ . Complete the online application form with required personal, educational, and professional details. Upload necessary documents and submit the application on or before 26.10.2026. Candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central/State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel or attach a No Objection Certificate from their employer, or produce it at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Screening of applications will be based on qualifications, age, and relevant experience. NeGD reserves the right to fix a higher threshold of qualifications and experience for screening and limiting the number of candidates for interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews. NeGD reserves the right not to select any of the candidates without assigning any reason thereof.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit applications for NeGD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 26.10.2026.

faq.question: Q2. Are these positions permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The positions are purely on a contract basis initially for a period of 3 years, which is further extendable as per the requirement of the project.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 55 years on the closing date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Screening of applications is based on qualifications, age, and relevant experience, and NeGD reserves the right to fix a higher threshold to limit the number of candidates invited for interviews.
